subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the average marks obtained by each student of 6 classes C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 and C6 in a school.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77fd101fd2f46cdf53eadb75e4e01c6cd03047618ea288ea0a8cedd9b889043f.png] 

Average marks of each students of which class is 100% of the average marks of each student of class C2?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Class
 Average Marks Obtained
 
 

 C1
 86
 
 

 C2
 89
 
 

 C3
 74
 
 

 C4
 89
 
 

 C5
 73
 
 

 C6
 95
 
 

**Formula Used:**

Required Average Marks = 100% × Average Marks of Class C2

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ Average marks obtained by each student of class C2 = 89

⇒ Marks required to be 100% of class C2 = (100 ÷ 100) × 89 = 89

⇒ Now, comparing this value with the average marks of other classes:

⇒ Average marks of C1 = 86

⇒ Average marks of C3 = 74

⇒ Average marks of C4 = 89

⇒ Average marks of C5 = 73

⇒ Average marks of C6 = 95

⇒ We can see that the average marks of class C4 is 89, which is exactly 100% of the average marks of class C2.

**∴ The correct answer is C4.**
